observations: wire_size returns len(body), which counts characters for str, not UTF-8 bytes as the behavior_contract requires.
For str input, len('한글') is 2 characters while UTF-8 encoding is 6 bytes, so p1 is predicted to return 2 instead of 6.
For bytes input, len(b'AB') is 2, matching the byte count, so p2 is predicted to return 2 correctly.
For empty str, len('') is 0, matching the UTF-8 byte count, so p3 is predicted to return 0 correctly.
The changed line 2 is the sole implementation; no encoding step (e.g., body.encode('utf-8')) is present.
static_findings is empty, so no tooling flagged the str/bytes length discrepancy.
